errors.text_span: всяка линия има по една точка в началото и една в края
errors.evidence: The lines in the chart are continuous segments. There are no explicit visual elements like "точки" (points) at the beginning or end of each line.

The description incorrectly states that the lines have "правоъгълни маркери" (rectangular markers). The lines in the figure are solid but have no markers of any shape. This error is repeated for all three line descriptions.

errors.text_span: завършва при стойност около 10 000 хил.лв. в края, като визуално показва почти хоризонтално положение
errors.evidence: The blue line for "Печалба" clearly shows a decrease. It starts at a value just over 10,000 and ends at a value visibly below 10,000 (approximately 9,000). Describing it as ending around 10,000 and having a nearly horizontal position is incorrect.

errors.text_span: завършва при стойност около 68 000 хил.лв. в края
errors.evidence: The orange line, representing "Оборот", ends at a value almost exactly on the 70,000 grid line. The reported value of 68,000 is an inaccurate approximation.

errors.text_span: показвайки по-отчетливо положително наклонение в сравнение с останалите две линии
errors.evidence: The generation prompt explicitly instructs to avoid comparing the lines. This phrase compares the slope of the grey line to the other two lines, which violates the instruction.

errors.evidence: The grey line ("Стойност на активите") and the orange line ("Оборот") begin at the same approximate value (around 65,000). Therefore, the statement that the grey line is "always the highest" is incorrect.
